# awscc_storagegateway_volume (Resource)

Creates a cached iSCSI volume on a Storage Gateway. A cached volume stores data in Amazon S3 and retains a copy of frequently accessed data subsets locally.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the gateway on which to create the volume.
- `network_interface_id` (String) The network interface of the gateway on which to expose the iSCSI target. Only IPv4 addresses are accepted.
- `target_name` (String) The name of the iSCSI target used by an initiator to connect to a volume and used as a suffix for the target ARN.
- `volume_size_in_bytes` (Number) The size of the volume in bytes.

### Optional

- `kms_encrypted` (Boolean) Set to true to use Amazon S3 server-side encryption with your own KMS key, or false to use a key managed by Amazon S3.
- `kms_key` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of a symmetric customer master key (CMK) used for Amazon S3 server-side encryption.
- `snapshot_id` (String) The snapshot ID of the snapshot to restore as the new cached volume (e.g., snap-1122aabb).
- `source_volume_arn` (String) The ARN of an existing volume from which to create the new volume.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of up to 50 tags to assign to the volume. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) The date the volume was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `target_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the volume target, which includes the iSCSI target name.
- `volume_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the storage volume.
- `volume_attachment_status` (String) Indicates whether the storage volume is attached to or detached from the gateway.
- `volume_id` (String) The unique identifier of the volume, extracted from the ARN.
- `volume_status` (String) The status of the storage volume.
- `volume_type` (String) The type of the volume (CACHED iSCSI).
- `volume_used_in_bytes` (Number) The size of the data stored on the volume in bytes.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_storagegateway_volume.example
  identity = {
    volume_arn = "volume_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `volume_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the storage volume

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_storagegateway_volume.example
  id = "volume_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_storagegateway_volume.example "volume_arn"
```
